cmd:continue.note: :continue <text> sends the text; bare :continue opens the continue dialog (Ctrl+Enter sends, Esc closes and keeps the draft)

cmd:rate.note: :rate N rates the open session 1-10 through UpdateSessionRating; bare :rate (or :r) opens the rating dialog

global:shift-down/normal-mode-no-overlay.note: Shift-Down selects the next transcript event when no dialog or text field has the keys (also the Go menu and palette)

global:shift-up/normal-mode-no-overlay-n.note: Shift-Up selects the previous transcript event when no dialog or text field has the keys (also the Go menu and palette)

key:<Space>mm.note: Switch model / effort dialog from GetSessionModelSwitchOptions: the discovered models narrowed by the operator allowlist; effort rows from the ladder discovery reported for the model, else the compiled per-model ladder (rsi_common effort_ladder, G2), limited to the provider's switchable levels; Enter queues the switch for the next turn

key:F2.note: Rename session dialog (Enter renames through UpdateSessionTitle, Esc cancels); also the Session menu and the row context menu

key:[u.note: selects the previous user message in the transcript, wrapping to the last

key:]u.note: selects the next user message in the transcript, wrapping to the first

key:p.note: prompt preview dialog: the full launch prompt of the cursor session; j/k/G change session, Ctrl-D/U scroll, Enter opens it, p/q/Esc close

key:yy.note: copies the selected event text when the keys are in the transcript (after Shift-Down, ]u, a fold key or a click on an event), else the open session ID; also the Session menu

key:zs.note: shows or hides system events in the open transcript (View menu check item, palette)

key:zt.note: shows or hides thinking events in the open transcript (the TUI description says expand or collapse; the keymap table says show or hide, which is what the desktop does)

module:ui/overlay/model_switch.rs.note: the switch model / effort dialog (<Space>mm) and the launch model picker (Ctrl-M, :model; the model dropdown)

module:ui/overlay/prompt_preview.rs.note: prompt preview dialog (detail) and the Skill Preview over GetSkill (overlay-ref:skill-preview, hub #3062)

overlay-ref:continue-prompt.note: Ctrl-Enter (Cmd-Enter) sends the follow-up; ? (normal) help; Ctrl-Q closes keeping the draft; Ctrl-Y compile and Ctrl-Shift-G grammar into a preview with a / d; Ctrl-Alt-A AI command (Ctrl-A stays select-all) and Ctrl-Shift-A AI chat; Ctrl-V paste with images as @path (G1); the vim editor (G1)

overlay-ref:prompt-preview.note: prompt preview dialog: j/k/G, Ctrl-D/U, Enter, p/q/Esc, Space N, Space ;

overlay-ref:rate-session.note: rating dialog: 1-9 and 0 (= 10) pick, h/l and arrows step, Enter saves, Esc/q close, Space N, Space ;

overlay-ref:rename-session.note: rename dialog: type, Enter renames, Esc cancels

overlay-ref:switch-model-effort.note: switch dialog: j/k and g/G pick the model, h/l the effort, Enter queues for the next turn, Esc/q close, Space N, Space ;

overlay:prompt-preview-overlay.note: prompt preview dialog: j/k/G, Ctrl-D/U, Enter, p/q/Esc, Space N, Space ;

section:navigation-events-detail-view.note: Shift-Down/Up, ]u/[u and Up/Down scroll (slice 5); the mouse wheel scrolls natively; Ctrl-Shift-Right / Left grow and shrink the session list by 3 points between 20 % and 55 % (G2, remembered)

section:session-detail-input-bar-priorit.note: substitute: the message box is a native text field. Focused, it owns every key; Esc hands the keyboard back to the app keys and keeps the draft; Up/Down scroll the transcript from a one-line draft; i / a / o / O enter it with the TUI caret placement (G2). The Space and g leaders reach the app whenever the box is not focused, so the TUI's pass-through exceptions are not needed; vim editing inside the box is the input-bar sweep's (G1, local #70)

section:visibility-toggles-detail-view.note: Show tool events, Show system events and Show thinking events: View menu check items, palette, zs / zt keys, right-click a message for tools

section:yank.note: yy copies the open session ID, or the selected event text once the keys are in the transcript; right-click a message copies its text
